text: Implemented MvpaStream with lazy outcomes, foreach visitor, foldLeft aggregator, and explicit Continue/Stop control. MvpaEngine now collects through the same stream path. Added tests for local-engine equivalence, early stop before later feature materialization, upfront response/fold validation, and per-ROI failure continuation. Documented non-collecting and distributed boundaries. Verified with sbt mvpaJVM/test mvpaJS/test: 40/40 passed on both platforms. Repo-wide compileAll remains blocked by separate atlas provenance issue bd-01KWW08M5510JHY7J6N040GXKR.
